items.label: list_item
items.text: ·Using a volumetric pipette,place 25.0 cm² of an aqueous solution of the weak acid into a conical flask.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Add a few drops of phenolphthalein indicator.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Titrate against a solution of aqueous sodium hydroxide until the end point colour is obtained.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Note the volume of sodium hydroxide required. This is the minimum volume required to completelyreactwiththeacid.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Use a fresh 25.0 cm? sample of the same aqueous solution of theweak acid and the same aqueous solution of sodium hydroxide,but this time do not add the phenolphthalein.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Add only halfthevolume of sodium hydroxide required toreact with the acid.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Measure the pH of this solution. This pH value is equal to the pKa value of the acid.

items.label: text
items.text: SafetyNote:Weareye protectionandavoidskin contactwiththesolutions. Makesurethetopofthe buretteisbeloweyelevel when you fill it.
